title: Ozi Queue Phase 1: schema + _work_queue state
description: Extend lug schema with queue_state/readiness fields. Add _work_queue section to WAI-State.json. Update score_backlog.py to populate readiness field (ready/needs_refinement/blocked) based on PEV completeness score.

perceive.current_state: Lugs have no queue_state field. WAI-State.json has _work_queue.items (list of scored ROI items) but no readiness field. score_backlog.py scores by ROI but does not check PEV completeness for dispatch readiness.
evidence: cat WAI-State.json | jq '._work_queue' — items exist but no readiness field
cat WAI-Spoke/lugs/bytype/feature/open/*.json | jq '.queue_state' — returns null for all
tools/score_backlog.py — scores ROI but no readiness check

steps: 2. Add readiness classification to score_backlog.py: ready (PEV complete + ROI>=3), needs_refinement (PEV incomplete), blocked (has blocker_list entries not done)
3. Update _work_queue items in WAI-State.json to include readiness field
5. Update WAI-State.json.template to include readiness in _work_queue schema
6. Run score_backlog.py --update-state to populate readiness for all current items

done_when: python3 tools/score_backlog.py --update-state exits 0 and populates readiness fields

acceptance_criteria: score_backlog.py classifies each item as ready/needs_refinement/blocked
WAI-State.json reflects readiness state after --update-state run
Blocked check: lug has blocker_list with at least one item not in completed/
